title: Empirical Comparison of Lakefill Lisp vs Published Quantum Programming Languages (Q#, Quipper, Silq, Qrisp, Qualtran, Qunity, Tower)

root_cause_A_functional_bennett_tax.diagnosis: Nesting `within-apply` across `GF(2^8) -> GF(2^4) -> GF(2^2)` eagerly uncomputes inner sub-multipliers (`144` CCX forward + `288` CCX `S^-1` `erase-by` = `432` CCX/S-box, `80,640` CCX for AES-128).
root_cause_A_functional_bennett_tax.fix: Session-scoped `(with-and-session ...)` SSA `TempAND` DAG keeps all `34` Boyar-Peralta `AND` ancillas alive until the end of the S-box session and erases them in reverse topological order via `Law U4` (`mid-meas-x-cond-z`) with `0` Toffolis.

root_cause_B_unitary_ccx_vs_typechecked_.diagnosis: Silq `qfree` and Quipper `with_computed` forbid `H + M_Z + cond-CZ` (`M_X` uncomputation), forcing `2x` `CCX` (`68` CCX = `476` Clifford+T or `272` Gidney unitary T-gates per S-box).
root_cause_B_unitary_ccx_vs_typechecked_.fix: Lakefill `Law U4` statically tracks Hadamard-dual phase taint `QTainted[m, phi]` and discharges it on `(mid-meas-x-cond-z anc (c1 c2))`, cutting S-box cost to `34` `TempAND`s (`136` T-gates: `12.71x` Toffoli / `22.24x` T-count reduction vs naive, `2.0x` Toffoli / `3.5x` T-count reduction vs Silq).

root_cause_C_schoolbook_vs_sawtooth_qrom.diagnosis: Generic bit-by-bit controlled Gidney addition pays `~1.5 * n^2` `CCX` per `n`-bit multiplication (`6,175` at 64b, `24,639` at 128b, `98,175` at 256b).
root_cause_C_schoolbook_vs_sawtooth_qrom.fix: Babbush-Gidney sawtooth unary-iteration `QROM` (`N - 1` controlled / `N - 2` uncontrolled `TempAND`s + `M_X` uncompute) + windowed lookup-addition cuts `TempAND`s by `3.94x` (64b, `w=5`), `4.56x` (128b, `w=6`), and `5.30x` (256b, `w=7`).

root_cause_D_keccak_erase_by_qubit_time_.diagnosis: Generic in-place `erase-by` degree-3 algebraic inverse on `Keccak-f[200]` `chi_5` uses `0` persistent round ancillas (`240` wires total across 18 rounds!) at `20` CCX/row (`14,400` CCX), whereas Q#/Qrisp out-of-place `chi_5` uses `5` `TempAND`s/row (`3,600` `TempAND`s, `4.00x` fewer `AND`s) at `3,845` wires (`3,600` round-history qubits).
root_cause_D_keccak_erase_by_qubit_time_.fix: Lakefill expresses BOTH endpoints (`erase-by` `240`w/`14,400` CCX for qubit-constrained NISQ/early-FTQC QPUs and `(with-and-session ...)` out-of-place `3,845`w/`3,600` TempANDs or `k`-pebble Bennett schedules for `T`-factory-bound FTQC).

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: Minimal qubits (`288` AES-128, `240` Keccak-f[200]) via `erase-by`, but eager nested `within-apply` pays a `12.7x` Bennett re-uncomputation tax on tower S-boxes.

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.uncomputation_model: Session-scoped `(with-and-session ...)` SSA `TempAND` DAG + `Law U4` `M_X + cond-Z` + algebraic `erase-by` (`Law U1`) + Bennett pebbling
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.physical_hardware_grade_typing: Yes (`U1-U4` + `Phi1-Phi3` static type & physical-effect semiring + Lean 4 proofs)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.qrom_n_entries_toffolis: N - 1 ctrl (`7` at N=8) / N - 2 unctrl (`6` at N=8) + `0` uncompute CCX (`3.94x-5.30x` windowed mul speedup)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: Matches Q#/Qualtran/Qrisp `TempAND` & sawtooth `QROM` counts while statically typechecking `Law U4` phase taint AND `Phi1-Phi3` physical decoherence/crosstalk.

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.physical_hardware_grade_typing: No (runtime resource estimator only; no static clean-ancilla or phase-taint types)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.aes128_10r_toffoli_or_tempand: 6,800 forward (`13,464` full Grover oracle with active-cone pruning)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: Pioneered Boyar-Peralta `34-AND` + `MResetX` AES circuits, but omitting `CZ` fixup or mis-aliasing ancillas silently corrupts amplitudes without type errors.

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.physical_hardware_grade_typing: No (untyped `Qubit` handles; allows dynamic assert-terminate errors)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: Scalable Haskell circuit metaprogramming, but `with_computed` syntactically inverts gates (`2x` Toffolis vs `M_X` uncomputation) and lacks linear/clean-ancilla safety.

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.physical_hardware_grade_typing: No (logical `qfree`/`mfree`/`const` annotations only; no hardware noise/topology grades)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: First high-level automatic `qfree` uncomputation type system, but `M_X + cond-Z` uses `H` + `measure` (not `qfree`/`mfree`), forcing `2x` `CCX` (`68` vs `34` per S-box).

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.uncomputation_model: `QuantumSession` DAG dependency graph + `@auto_uncompute` pebble/measurement pass (`mcx(..., method='gidney')`)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.physical_hardware_grade_typing: No (Python runtime session compiler; no static type or physical-effect proof checker)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: Excellent practical `QuantumSession` `TempAND` & pebbling automation in Python, directly inspiring Lakefill's typed `(with-and-session ...)` combinator.

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.reference: Gidney (Quantum 2018; 2019), Babbush et al. (PRX 2018), Harrigan et al. (2024)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.physical_hardware_grade_typing: Partial (`QType` wire widths & `GateCounts` call graphs, no formal `U1-U4`/`Phi1-Phi3` soundness proofs)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.qrom_n_entries_toffolis: N - 2 unctrl / N - 1 ctrl TempANDs (`4N - 8` / `4N - 4` T-gates) + SelectSWAP QROAM
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: Gold-standard FTQC arithmetic (`TempAND`, sawtooth `QROM`, windowed `ModExp`), directly inspiring Lakefill's `qrom-sawtooth-lookup-sexpr` & windowed multiplier.

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.uncomputation_model: Symmetric pattern-matching / norm-preserving Krauss & algebraic Span-program compilation
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.physical_hardware_grade_typing: No (denotational operator semantics; compiles pattern matches into high-overhead multi-controlled unitaries)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: Unified quantum/classical `match` expressions, but lacks `TempAND` `M_X` uncomputation and incurs the same nested Bennett tax as naive generic Lakefill.

published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.uncomputation_model: Explicit reversible `<-` / `->` uncomputation & bounded pointer-based quantum data structures (`Law U1`-style)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.physical_hardware_grade_typing: No (tracks logical entanglement uncomputation of data structures, not `M_X` phase taint or Lindblad/crosstalk)
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.qrom_n_entries_toffolis: O(N log N) unitary RAM traversal
published_quantum_languages_comparison_t.key_strength_or_bottleneck: Pioneered pointer-based quantum data structures with unitary uncomputation, but lacks Gidney `M_X` uncomputation (`U4`), sawtooth `QROM`, and physical `Phi1-Phi3` grades.
